thread:
Anya: Quick sync — we need a scope decision for the milestone in two weeks. Too many asks floating; we either compress and ship a clean MVP or delay by one sprint. Strawman below.

Jon: Paste the strawman please. Need to evaluate engineering effort.

Anya: Strawman (very rough):
```
MVP (2-week target):
- Core API (text gen + streaming)
- Simple auth + tenant pinning
- Embeddings cache (read-through only)
- Basic Console: routes + latency dashboard

Deferred to v1:
- Advanced rollout A/B tooling
- Full per-token billing UI
- Multi-region active-active routing
- Admin analytics and custom eval pipeline
```

Sarah: UX note — if we strip the Console features to the bare minimum we should keep the onboarding flow intact (users can create a route and see latency). Anything beyond that becomes confusing.

Matt: Platform risk: embeddings cache read-through is doable but requires 2 days of infra work for safe eviction + tests. Multi-region routing definitely needs another sprint.

Jon: Engineering reality check: core API + streaming + tenant pinning + basic cache is borderline but OK if we freeze model pinning after the go/no-go. A/B rollout is a no-go for this milestone.

Tara: Sales asks — Acme pilot needs canary routing and per-route SLAs. If we can't deliver canary, we should give them a documented compensation plan or a delayed pilot date.

Anya: Proposed compromise: ship MVP on time with a canary workaround: provide a manual canary playbook and a config toggle `--manual-canary` for Dedicated customers. That reduces infra scope. Thoughts?

Jon: I like manual-canary as temporary mitigation. We'll add a tech-debt ticket to automate it in v1.

Matt: Agree. We'll need an ops runbook and a short maintenance window during rollout. release-bot, can you reserve the 2-hour window on Thu 09:00-11:00 UTC?

release-bot: Scheduled: 2-hour release window on Thu 09:00-11:00 UTC (ID: rw-rel-1798). Reminder will go out 24h prior.

Sarah: Design will trim Console flows to: Create Route -> Select Model -> View Live Latency. No admin analytics shown. We'll flag hidden screens with `beta` labels for v1.

Tara: I'll communicate to Acme: MVP will include a documented manual canary and SLA baseline; automated canary and advanced billing UI targeted for v1. Will ask if they can accept the go/no-go.

Anya: OK decision then: ship MVP (2-week) with the strawman list, include `--manual-canary` and ops runbook. Defer A/B, billing UI, multi-region, admin analytics to v1.

Jon: Action items:
- Jon: freeze model pinning API for this milestone (owner).
- Matt: infra for embeddings cache + eviction tests (owner).
- Sarah: Console minimal flows + banners (owner).
- Tara: customer comms to Acme + update pilot timeline (owner).
- Anya: create rollout ticket + add tech-debt items for v1 (owner).

Anya: I'll update the milestone doc now and push a short summary to stakeholders. If anyone strongly objects, call it out now, otherwise we move forward. :white_check_mark:

Jon: No objections from eng. :+1:

Matt: No objections from platform.

Tara: Acme flagged that they prefer canary automation but will accept the manual approach if we give clear deliverables for v1.

Anya: Great — I'm locking this as the official scope decision for the milestone. I'll post a short Milestone Summary in Confluence and link here.

Anya: Milestone summary (to paste into Confluence):
```
Milestone: MVP-202 (2-week window)
Target ship date: Thu (release window ID: rw-rel-1798)
Scope (in): Core API, streaming, auth + tenant pinning, embeddings cache (read-through), minimal Console (routes + latency), manual canary playbook
Scope (out): A/B rollout automation, per-token billing UI, multi-region active-active, admin analytics, custom eval pipeline
Risks: embeddings eviction correctness (mitigation: extra tests), Acme canary expectations (mitigation: documented manual process + timeline for automation in v1)
Owners: Anya (PM), Jon (Eng), Matt (Platform), Sarah (Design), Tara (Sales)
```

Jon: Thanks — will break down tickets and post capacity numbers by EOD.

Sarah: Will hand off trimmed mocks by EOD tomorrow.

Tara: I'll confirm with Acme and report back.

Anya: Closing thread — we'll treat this as the official scope unless anyone raises a major blocker within 24h. :locked:
